release.outlook_text: The Company reported strong first quarter results, and reiterated its full year 2022 guidance, which excludes Russia for the remainder of the year. We continue to expect $2.45-$2.50 billion of sales with organic growth of 4%-7% and total reported sales growth of 2%-4%, full year adjusted EBITDA of $400-$420 million, adjusted EPS of $3.85-$4.05 and free cash flow of greater than $210 million.
release.notes_on_special_items: Adjusted NI excludes Restructuring and other related charges (5.3), acquisition-related amortization (7.7, amortization of acquired intangibles) and Separation costs (3.6); tax adjustment (3.8) at 29.4% effective rate. Adj. EBITDA recon removes only interest income, net (0.5) from "Interest income and other, net"; the residual other income 0.1 appears as segment line "Other income (expense), net" (Americas 0.3 / EMEA & APAC (0.2)). Free cash flow (called "Free cash flow", not "adjusted") adds back Separation payments 5.0 ($3.6m tax paid in preparation for the separation + $1.4m other) and discontinued operations 4.6, and includes proceeds from sale of certain properties 2.5.

notes: PRE-SPIN QUARTER: ESAB operated as part of Enovis (formerly Colfax) for all of Q1-2022 (Separation completed 4-Apr-2022). Statements are COMBINED carve-out statements; equity is "Net Parent investment" (mapped to retained_earnings_or_net_parent_investment); no debt on balance sheet (1.2bn consideration to parent and term loans funded in Q2).
Interest: IS line is "Interest income and other, net" = +0.556 income -> interest_expense_other_net = -0.556 (sign flipped to expense-positive convention). No third-party interest expense pre-spin.

EPS/shares: per 10-Q Note 4, basic and diluted EPS computed using 60,034,311 shares distributed at Separation for all pre-spin periods (no dilutive securities). shares_basic = shares_diluted = 60.034311. Release adj. EPS uses 60.0m diluted shares. Income from continuing ops attributable to ESAB = 57.458 (EPS note).
dps_declared = 0.0: no dividends declared in Q1-2022 (first $0.05 dividend declared in Q2-2022).
Product lines: 10-Q revenue note discloses Equipment / Consumables totals only; no segment split.
Release labelled metric "Free cash flow" (renamed "Adjusted free cash flow" from Q2-2022).

Pension settlement gain is shown in the IS as a negative amount on an expense-sign basis (printed as "(x)"); kept as printed in pension_settlement_or_other_nonop; IS check uses pretax = OI - pension_line - interest_expense_other_net.

asbestos_insurance_assets = long-term asbestos insurance asset + long-term asbestos insurance receivable (Commitments & Contingencies note; both included in Other assets); asbestos_liabilities_total = accrued (current, in Accrued liabilities) + long-term (in Other liabilities) asbestos liability. Derived sums.
prepaid_other_current = Prepaid expenses + Other current assets (summed).
common_stock_apic = Common stock + Additional paid-in capital (summed) where present.

cf_ytd: "Consideration to Former Parent in connection with the Separation" and "Transfers from (to) Former Parent, net" both mapped to net_transfers_to_parent; revolver_net combines proceeds and repayments of revolving credit facility "and other" lines.
Release figures (segments, recons, sales change, FCF) are in USD millions as printed (rounded to 0.1); small non-zero checks reflect release rounding ("Numbers may not sum due to rounding").
